item.title: Senate Finance and Taxation Education Committee passes bill to repeal UA School of Social Work requirement
item.description: The Senate Finance and Taxation Education Committee passed a bill on Wednesday to remove language in state statute requiring the University of Alabama (UA) School of Social Work to remain a standalone college under the authority of the Board of Trustees.The bill was introduced by State Rep. Danny Garrett (R-Trussville) following conversations with the University, as the state moves toward a program that will incentivize outcome-based initiatives. item.title: Alabama Court of Civil Appeals backs AHSAA ruling Oakwood Adventist basketball ineligible for postseason play
item.description: The Alabama Court of Civil Appeals sided with the Alabama High School Athletic Association’s (AHSAA) ruling that Oakwood Adventist will be ineligible for the upcoming postseason.Oakwood Adventist Academy was fined and placed on one-year probation for the boys’ varsity basketball program exceeding the maximum number of contests allowed in the regular season by one game. item.title: Ivey signs Child Predator Death Penalty Act into law
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey on Thursday signed the Child Predator Death Penalty Act into law. One of the governor’s top priorities this legislative session, the new law provides the strongest legal protection for Alabama’s children from child predators. item.title: Scott Stadthagen taking ‘leave of absence’ as House majority leader, Chip Brown named interim
item.description: House Majority Leader Scott Stadthagen (R-Hartselle) is taking a leave of absence for a few weeks as majority leader, according to multiple sources.Stadthagen announced recently he is running for Alabama Republican Party (ALGOP) chairman.
